note: Declared LLM call sites. Registered into LightTrack via `lt use-cases register`; the gap between this declaration and observed events.name is the coverage report.

use_cases.name: Recalibrate notebook edits into a script edit-plan
use_cases.description: Turns a creator's notes plus the current render table into a validated edit plan for the script.

use_cases.name: Compose candidate scripts from a creator's notebook
use_cases.description: Turns a notebook, the creator's kept cards, the template and the target runtime into up to three candidate renders on the engines the notebook rates good or better (pipeline/SCRIPT-PROMPT.md); validated by lib/script/validate.ts::parseDraft and gated per candidate, or refused as no-engine-fits.

use_cases.name: Direct scene specs from a script and notebook
use_cases.description: Turns a script and notebook into per-render scene/art-direction specs for the frames pipeline.

use_cases.name: Synthesize named styles from a foundry gallery
use_cases.description: Turns a gallery's vision-readbacks into named styles with reusable generation recipes for one foundry extract run.

use_cases.name: Draft a Sound lab hunt map
use_cases.description: Turns an operator's musical or sound-effect problem into a map of variation axes ending in concrete, renderable prompts (pipeline/SOUND-HUNT-PROMPT.md), validated before a node is kept.

use_cases.name: Draft a lesson from a finished hunt
use_cases.description: Turns a hunt's winners and losers into one drafted 'when X, brief Y, because Z' claim (pipeline/SOUND-LESSON-PROMPT.md); evidence is counted by code and a human confirms before anything is stored.

use_cases.name: Research a technical blog post on the live web
use_cases.description: An agent turn with WebSearch/WebFetch/Read/Write/Edit in an isolated workspace: a topic and the registry's post standard in, numbered dated sources and claims out (pipeline/ARTICLE-POST-PROMPT.md, research section). Validated in lib/articles/engine.ts before anything is kept.

use_cases.name: Outline and draft a technical blog post
use_cases.description: Two agent turns with Read/Write/Edit only (no web): the research in, an outline, then the post as a self-contained page, Medium-ready Markdown, SVG figures and optional registry patch proposals out (pipeline/ARTICLE-POST-PROMPT.md, outline and draft sections). Checked deterministically by lib/articles/checks.ts; a human approves before anything reaches the registry.

use_cases.name: Review a drafted technical blog post (multi-model critique)
use_cases.description: One reviewer of the critique panel (pipeline/article-reviewers.json), run read-only with web access through the local claude, codex, grok or agy CLI on the operator's own login: the post, its sources and the registry's post standard in (pipeline/ARTICLE-REVIEW-PROMPT.md), one JSON review out in the final message, validated in lib/articles/critique.ts before it is kept. Reviewers run in parallel, blind to each other, at most two rounds.

use_cases.name: Answer the critique of a technical blog post, and revise it
use_cases.description: The writer's turns inside the critique, with the draft's model and Read/Write/Edit only: one disposition (accepted, rejected or deferred, with a reason) per reviewer finding and a keep/rewrite/research decision (pipeline/ARTICLE-POST-PROMPT.md, critique section), then on rewrite the whole post again (revise section). A research decision runs a text.article-research turn first. Validated in lib/articles/critique.ts; a human approves before anything reaches the registry.

use_cases.name: Author a code-rendered video strip
use_cases.description: An agent turn with Read/Write/Edit only (no web) in an isolated workspace: a brief with fetched data or facts, one artistic approach card and the strip contract (pipeline/strips/CONTRACT.md) in; a frame-pure strip.html and its style.json module out. Linted for frame purity and rendered headless by pipeline/strips before an operator triages it in /foundry; a fix turn reads the contact sheet and gate results, at most twice.

use_cases.name: Text engine availability probe
use_cases.description: Zero-token health check that walks the text engine's provider chain to report which one would serve a given turn, without generating anything.

use_cases.name: Vision-language readback for image recognition
use_cases.description: Reads back a description or structured extraction from an image for the imaging pipeline (e.g. foundry style extraction).
